decisionReason: The first system attempt at orchestration commit 2131e4a667d0fecab2f4fda1ea3518b0db7891c4 was blocked before element assembly because the runtime patch incorrectly invented profileId LINEAR-FRAME-ELEMENT-R1-TIMOSHENKO-COWPER-0P53.
